name: FA_ADJUSTMENTS_T
description: FA_ADJUSTMENTS_T is an interface table used for mass financial transactions.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Adjustment interface identifier.

columns.name: PARENT_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Parent interface identifier.

columns.name: POSTING_STATUS
columns.description: Posting status. Valid values: NEW, POST, ON HOLD. NEW means the asset is new. POST means the asset is ready to be posted. ON HOLD means the asset needs further review.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Asset identifier. Use an Assets work area to identify valid values.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Asset book. Use the Manage Asset Books task to identify valid values.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction type. Valid values: ADJUSTMENT, SUSPEND RESUME, RECLASS, UNPLANNED, DELETE, GROUP CHANGE, CAPITALIZATION, CIP REVERSE, RESERVE TRANSFER, INVOICE ADDITION, INVOICE ADJUSTMENT, INVOICE DELETE, INVOICE REINSTATE, INVOICE DEP, INVOICE NO DEP, INVOICE TRANSFER.

columns.name: COST
columns.description: Asset cost. Enter without thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: DATE_PLACED_IN_SERVICE
columns.description: Date asset was placed in service. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.name: DEPRECIATE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the asset must be depreciated. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: METHOD_ID
columns.description: Depreciation method identifier. Use the Manage Depreciation Methods task to identify valid values.

columns.name: FLAT_RATE_ID
columns.description: Flat rate identifier. Use the Manage Depreciation Methods task to identify valid values.

columns.name: CEILING_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Ceiling type identifier. Use the Manage Ceilings task to identify valid values.

columns.name: CONVENTION_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Convention type identifier. Use the Manage Prorate Conventions task to identify valid values.

columns.name: BONUS_RULE_ID
columns.description: Bonus rule identifier. Use the Manage Bonus Rules task to identify valid values.

columns.name: YTD_DEPRN
columns.description: Year-to-date depreciation. Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Accumulated depreciation for the asset. Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: BONUS_YTD_DEPRN
columns.description: Year-to-date bonus depreciation. Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: BONUS_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Bonus depreciation reserve. Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: AMORTIZE_FLAG
columns.description: Amortize the asset. Valid values: Y, N. Enter a value for AMORTIZATION_START_DATE if Y is used.

columns.name: AMORTIZATION_START_DATE
columns.description: Amortization start date. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD. Only used if AMORTIZE_FLAG is set to Y. Cannot be earlier than the date the asset is placed in service.

columns.name: DEPRN_LIMIT_TYPE
columns.description: Depreciation limit type. Valid values: PCT, AMT, SUM, NONE. PCT means percent. AMT means amount. SUM means sum of member assets.

columns.name: ALLOWED_DEPRN_LIMIT
columns.description: Depreciation limit percentage for the asset.  Must be between 0 and 100.

columns.name: ALLOWED_DEPRN_LIMIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Depreciation limit. Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: SALVAGE_TYPE
columns.description: Salvage type. Valid values: PCT, AMT, SUM. PCT means percent. AMT means amount. SUM means sum of member assets.

columns.name: SALVAGE_VALUE
columns.description: Salvage value. Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator. Cannot exceed asset cost.

columns.name: PERCENT_SALVAGE_VALUE
columns.description: Salvage value as a percentage of asset cost. Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator. Must be between 0 and 100.

columns.name: SHORT_FISCAL_YEAR_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the asset was added during a short fiscal year. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: CONVERSION_DATE
columns.description: Date asset added during short fiscal year was entered into service. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD. Must be within current calendar period of parent company.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_DEPRN_START_DATE
columns.description: Date short tax year asset begin depreciating in the acquired company''s books.  Date format: YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NAME
columns.description: Transaction name for the asset. Free text field. No validations.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Category identifier. Use the Manage Asset Categories task to identify valid values.

columns.name: COPY_CATEGORY_DFF_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the descriptive flexfield information must be copied to the asset category. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: INHERIT_DEF_RULES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether depreciation rules of the new category must be inherited. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.description: Unit of measure used for depreciation using units of production method. Use the Manage Units of Measure task to identify valid values.

columns.name: CURRENT_YTD_DEPRN
columns.description: Current value of the year-to-date depreciation expense. Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: CURRENT_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Current depreciation reserve. Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: CURRENT_BONUS_YTD_DEPRN
columns.description: Current value of the bonus year-to-date depreciation expense. Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: CURRENT_BONUS_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Current value of the total bonus depreciation for the asset. Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: YTD_IMPAIRMENT
columns.description: Year-to-date impairment amount. Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: CURRENT_YTD_IMPAIRMENT
columns.description: Current value of the year-to-date impairment amount. Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: CURRENT_IMPAIRMENT_RESERVE
columns.description: Current value of the total impairment loss recognized for the asset. Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: CURRENT_BACKLOG_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Backlog depreciation reserve for an asset before revaluation.

columns.name: CURRENT_REVALUED_COST
columns.description: Revalued cost of an asset before revaluation.

columns.description: Unplanned depreciation amount. Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.description: Oracle Fusion Enterprise Resource Planning: request ID of the process that created or last updated the row.

columns.description: Group asset identifier. Use asset inquiry in any work area to identify valid values.

columns.name: REDUCTION_RATE
columns.description: Depreciation reduction percentage. Must be between 0 and 100.

columns.name: REDUCE_ADDITION_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether depreciation reduction to be considered for addition transaction.  Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: REDUCE_ADJUSTMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether depreciation reduction to be considered for adjustment transaction.  Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: REDUCE_RETIREMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether depreciation reduction is to be considered for retirement transaction.  Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: RECOGNIZE_GAIN_LOSS
columns.description: Recognize gain or loss from member asset retirement. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: RECAPTURE_RESERVE_FLAG
columns.description: Reserve for group asset can exceed recoverable cost. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: LIMIT_PROCEEDS_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the member asset proceed of sale to be limited to its recoverable cost. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: TERMINAL_GAIN_LOSS
columns.description: Indicates how terminal gain or loss is recognized for member asset retirement. Valid values: YES, NO, END_OF_YEAR.

columns.name: TRACKING_METHOD
columns.description: Calculation method for group asset depreciation. Valid values: ALLOCATE, CALCULATE. ALLOCATE means allocate group depreciation amount to member assets. CALCULATE means calculate depreciation for each member asset.

columns.name: EXCESS_ALLOCATION_OPTION
columns.description: Allocate excess depreciation for group asset to member assets or reduce from the group asset depreciation. Valid values: DISTRIBUTE, REDUCE.

columns.name: DEPRECIATION_OPTION
columns.description: Indicates whether the member asset''s depreciation expense is calculated using its group asset depreciation rules or the member asset depreciation rules. Valid values: GROUP, MEMBER.

columns.name: MEMBER_ROLLUP_FLAG
columns.description: Roll up group depreciation to the group asset. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: ALLOCATE_TO_FULLY_RSV_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to allocate group asset depreciation amount to a reserved member asset.  Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: OVER_DEPRECIATE_OPTION
columns.description: Allow over depreciation for group assets. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: DISABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Group asset is enabled. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: GROUP_CHANGE_TYPE
columns.description: Group asset reclass rule for depreciation reserve calculation for transferring assets between group assets. Valid values: MANUAL, CALC.

columns.name: GROUP_CHANGE_RESERVE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Depreciation reserve amount transferred from one group asset to another group asset.Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: SOURCE_EOFY_RESERVE
columns.description: Source asset depreciation reserve amount of the group asset, from which depreciation reserve is transferred. Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: DESTINATION_EOFY_RESERVE
columns.description: Destination asset depreciation reserve amount of the group asset to which depreciation reserve is transferred. Enter without thousands. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.
